name: Melithar Staghelm
summary: Melithar Staghelm is a night elf stationed just outside Aldrassil in Shadowglen, Teldrassil's starting glade. He assists young night elf adventurers as they embark on their early training, sending them to learn what has brought the dryad Tarindrella back to the glade. While he shares the prominent Staghelm surname with Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, his exact connection to the ruling druid remains unconfirmed.

sections.title: A Guide at Aldrassil
sections.body: Standing directly outside the entrance to the great bough of Aldrassil, Melithar serves as an early point of contact for night elves emerging into the world. A druid who listens to the whisperings of the forest spirits, he has learned that the mysterious woodland protector Tarindrella has returned to Shadowglen after years away. Sensing that something is amiss, Melithar sends newcomers to seek out the dryad southwest of Aldrassil and learn what business brings her to the grove.

sections.title: The Staghelm Name
sections.body: Bearing the surname Staghelm inevitably draws attention, as Archdruid Fandral Staghelm currently leads the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus following Malfurion Stormrage's disappearance into the Emerald Dream. However, Melithar makes no outward boast of grand heritage, nor does he actively speak of his lineage. Whether he is a distant kinsman of the Archdruid's venerable family line or merely shares an ancient Kaldorei family name, Melithar remains content fulfilling humble duties at the roots of Aldrassil.

faq.answer: Melithar Staghelm is a night elf quest giver stationed on the pathway outside the bough of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. He helps newly arrived night elf adventurers get their bearings and sends them to find the dryad Tarindrella.

faq.q: Is Melithar related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm?
faq.answer: Their exact kinship is unknown. While they share the Staghelm name, Melithar never comments on being related to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm or his late son Valstann. It remains unclear whether he is a distant relative or simply shares a common Kaldorei surname.

faq.q: What role does Melithar play for new adventurers?
faq.answer: Melithar has heard through the whisperings of the forest spirits that the dryad Tarindrella, the woodland protector, has returned to Shadowglen after years away. He sends novices to find her southwest of Aldrassil and learn what business brings her to the grove.

faq.q: Where can I find Melithar Staghelm?
faq.answer: He stands right on the wooden rampway outside the entrance of Aldrassil, in the center of Shadowglen on Teldrassil.

angles.text: For night elves embarking on their journey in Shadowglen, Melithar is one of the very first faces encountered after departing Aldrassil's shelter.
